notes: Flat-only additive model in people: one intercept (the reference location) plus one flat contribution per displayed attribute class. No percent modifiers, no per-location term.
Quantile objective: tau is the share of locations allowed to sit above the attribute value (overshoot); 1-tau undershoot. The fit is a low envelope, not a mean.
Prior spans are shares of the reference scale (median ownable natural capacity) so they survive the global fill rescale; the maximum-capacity target uses span_multiplier times the same shares.
The zero floor holds over every attribute combination, observed or not, through group-minimum slacks.
Targets are the people-denominated capacity targets; population never enters.

Sign expectations are enforced as one-sided spans (negative classes may not add capacity; positive classes may not remove it), so a fitted value of zero means the data did not support the expected direction.

Targets are converted to flat (pre-development) units before fitting: natural/(1+c*D_start) and maximum/(1+c*100), because the game multiplies every flat value by (1 + c*development). Development comes from artifacts/development/locations.csv and is never adjusted here.

round_to: after the fit, the intercept and every class value are rounded to the nearest multiple of this many people (the zero floor is preserved by lifting the intercept if needed); predictions, metrics and the review list use the rounded values.
